title: MedInsightBench: Evaluating Medical Analytics Agents Through Multi-Step Insight Discovery in Multimodal Medical Data
abstract: arXiv:2512.13297v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In medical data analysis, extracting deep insights from complex, multi-modal datasets is essential for improving patient care, increasing diagnostic accuracy, and optimizing healthcare operations. However, there is currently a lack of high-quality datasets specifically designed to evaluate the ability of large multi-modal models (LMMs) to discover medical insights. In this paper, we introduce MedInsightBench, the first benchmark that comprises 332 carefully curated medical cases, each annotated with thoughtfully designed insights. This benchmark is intended to evaluate the ability of LMMs and agent frameworks to analyze multi-modal medical image data, including posing relevant questions, interpreting complex findings, and synthesizing actionable insights and recommendations. translated_title: MedInsightBench：通过多模态医学数据中的多步骤洞察发现评估医学分析智能体
translated_abstract: 在医学数据分析中，从复杂的多模态数据集中提取深层洞察，对于改善患者护理、提高诊断准确性和优化医疗运营至关重要。然而，目前缺乏专门设计用于评估大型多模态模型（LMMs）发现医学洞察能力的高质量数据集。在本文中，我们提出了MedInsightBench，这是首个包含332个精心筛选的医学案例的基准数据集，每个案例均标注了经过缜密设计的洞察。该基准旨在评估LMMs和智能体框架分析多模态医学图像数据的能力，包括提出相关问题、解读复杂发现，以及综合生成可操作的洞察与建议。我们的分析表明，现有的LMMs在MedInsightBench上的表现较为有限，这主要归因于它们在提取多步骤洞察方面存在困难。
tldr: 提出首个用于评估大型多模态模型和智能体框架在多模态医学图像数据上进行多步骤医学洞察发现能力的基准MedInsightBench，包含332个精心标注的医学案例，并揭示现有模型表现仍然有限。
en_tdlr: Introduces MedInsightBench, the first benchmark of 332 carefully curated and annotated medical cases for evaluating LMMs and agent frameworks' multi-step insight discovery in multimodal medical image data, revealing that existing models show limited performance.
